title: Upcoming GPT Chat Latest update, and GPT-6 Luna is now available for a more flexible upgrade cadence.
summary: GPT Chat Latest now updates regularly with monthly versions (e.g., November), allowing 30 days to test before automatic upgrade on December 23, 2026. GPT-6 Luna offers a longer upgrade window with two options for response style. Users should identify affected agents, test, and consider switching to GPT-6 Luna for flexibility.
body:
[What and why]

Thank you for your feedback on recent model changes for agents on the Standard harness in Microsoft Copilot Studio. We know frequent model migrations take time and effort from your makers and admins. We want model updates to be more predictable and easier to plan for. 

[Impact on your organization]

GPT Chat Latest is getting its first regular update. 

GPT Chat Latest is a specific GPT chat model from OpenAI. Instead of releasing separate, numbered chat models, OpenAI now keeps this one model up to date with regular improvements in quality, reasoning and response behavior. 

To make these updates clearer, the model picker shows the month after the model's name, for example GPT Chat Latest (November). 

What you see in the model picker Status GPT Chat Latest (October)Used by your agents todayGPT Chat Latest (November)New update, available to test now

We expect minimal changes in behavior when moving from GPT Chat Latest (October) to GPT Chat Latest (November), but we recommend testing your business-critical agents. To give you time to validate:

- You have 30 days to test your agents on GPT Chat Latest (November). During this time, you can choose between the October and November versions.- On 23 December 2026, agents using GPT Chat Latest (October) will automatically move to GPT Chat Latest (November). No manual change is required.

GPT Chat Latest will continue to update regularly as OpenAI releases new versions. When a new version is released, the previous version remains available for 30 days. This period can't be extended, and the "Continue using retired models" setting doesn't apply to GPT Chat Latest.

GPT-6 Luna: recommended if you need a longer upgrade window

GPT-6 Luna is available now on the Standard harness. Before a model upgrade, you get 30 days' notice by default. You can extend this by another 30 days (up to 60 days in total) by turning on "Continue using retired models" in the agent's settings.

GPT-6 Luna comes in two options;

- Quick response – optimized for lower latency responses- Think deeper – deeper reasoning for more complex problemsIn our internal evaluations, GPT-6 Luna has performed well across common Standard harness scenarios; better than GPT 5.5 Chat and Think Deeper is on par with GPT Chat Latest. 

If you need more time to move to new model versions, we recommend switching to GPT-6 Luna (Quick response or Think deeper).

[Action required and recommendations]

Before December 23, 2026:

- Identify affected agents. In the Power Platform admin center, go to Manage > Copilot Studio. Review your agents by harness and model to find those using GPT Chat Latest, and let their owners know.- Switch to GPT-6 Luna (Quick response or Think deeper) for a longer upgrade window.- Test your agents. Check response accuracy, key workflows, tool and action execution, and business-critical integrations.- Make changes where needed. Adjust agent instructions or configuration based on your test results.

Looking ahead

Models are improving faster than ever, so set up a regular process to evaluate your agents against new models. For new or complex agents, we recommend the Microsoft Copilot harness. It gives your agents the latest reasoning models, handles longer multi-step tasks, and recovers automatically when a step fails.

[Learn more]

- Standard harness model availability- Copilot Studio model lifecycle guidance- How the Microsoft Copilot harness helps agents complete complex tasks | Microsoft Copilot Blog- Test your agent- Chat Latest Model | OpenAI API
